items.title: will 与 be going to 的语义差别
items.brief: 看决定何时作出、预测依据是什么

concept.summary: will 与 be going to 都指向将来，分界在“决定作出的时刻”和“预测的依据”。will 用于说话当下才作出的决定、承诺与请求，也用于说话人的主观判断；be going to 用于说话前已经想好的打算，或眼前已有迹象的预测。句中出现 I think、probably 倾向 will，出现 Look at...、I've decided 倾向 be going to。

sections.p: 判断标准是决定发生在说话之前还是说话之中。说话之中临时决定、主动承担、提出请求，用 will；说话之前已经想好、已经做了准备，用 be going to。
bullets: 当场决定：The phone is ringing. I'll answer it.
事先打算：I'm going to sell my car next month; I've already placed an ad.
主动提供：Don't worry, I'll carry the box for you.
请求：Will you close the window, please?

sections.p: 预测分两种：凭经验与判断的推测用 will，眼前有可见证据的预测用 be going to。证据可以是天气、迹象，也可以是已经显露的潜质。
bullets: 主观判断：I think it will snow tonight.
可见迹象：Look at those clouds. It's going to rain.
有把握的推论：She's going to be a fine doctor; she has the patience for it.

sections.h: 两个将来标记不能叠加
sections.p: will 与 be going to 都是将来标记，一个谓语只能带一个。写成 will going to 等于把两个标记压进同一个谓语，属于结构错误。
bullets: × I will going to study abroad.
√ I am going to study abroad.
√ I will study abroad.

examples.en: The phone is ringing. I'll answer it.
examples.zh: 电话响了，我去接。
examples.note: 铃响的瞬间才产生决定，属当场决定，用 will。

examples.en: I'm going to sell my car next month; I've already placed an ad.
examples.zh: 我下个月打算把车卖掉，广告都登出去了。
examples.note: 广告已登，说明打算在说话前就形成，用 be going to。

examples.en: Look at those black clouds. It's going to rain.
examples.zh: 看那些乌云，要下雨了。
examples.note: 乌云是眼前可见的迹象，预测用 be going to。

examples.en: I think he will pass the exam.
examples.zh: 我觉得他会通过考试。
examples.note: I think 表明这是主观判断，用 will。

examples.en: Look at those black clouds. It will rain.
examples.zh: 看那些乌云，要下雨了。
examples.note: 已有可见迹象的预测用 be going to，应改为 It's going to rain.

examples.en: I will going to visit my aunt this weekend.
examples.zh: 这个周末我打算去看姑姑。
examples.note: will 与 be going to 不能叠加，删去其中一个。

examples.en: She is going to have a baby in July.
examples.zh: 她七月要生孩子了。
examples.note: 既成事实的将来用 be going to，不用 will 表意愿。

examples.en: Will you help me with this box?
examples.zh: 你能帮我抬一下这个箱子吗？
examples.note: 请求对方做事用 will 引导的一般疑问句。

pitfalls.wrong: I will going to study abroad next year.
pitfalls.right: I am going to study abroad next year.
pitfalls.why: will 与 be going to 是两套将来标记，同一个谓语只能保留一套。

pitfalls.wrong: Don't worry about the box. I am going to carry it for you.
pitfalls.right: Don't worry about the box. I'll carry it for you.
pitfalls.why: 主动提供是在说话中临时承担，be going to 要求事先已有打算，与语境不符。
will 是情态动词，后面直接接动词原形，不带不定式符号 to。

contrast.withTitle: 现在进行时与一般现在时表将来
contrast.diff: will 与 be going to 是通用将来标记，远近皆可；进行时表将来只覆盖已安排的具体行程，一般现在时只覆盖机构时刻表。

concept.mnemonic: 当场决定用 will，事先打算 going to；眼见为实用 going to，主观猜测用 will。

core: will：当场决定、承诺、主动提供、请求
be going to：说话前已打算；有可见迹象的预测
信号词 I think/probably 倾向 will；Look at.../I've decided 倾向 going to
一个谓语只能有一个将来标记，will 与 going to 不叠加
will 后接动词原形，不带 to
review.trigger: 先问“决定是什么时候作出的” → 说话之中用 will，说话之前用 be going to → 再问“预测有没有证据”

quickCheck.q: 电话铃响时你说“我去接”，用哪个？
看到乌云说“要下雨了”，用哪个？
Will you to help me? 错在哪里？
quickCheck.a: will 后直接接原形，改为 Will you help me?

drills.explain: 铃响的瞬间才产生去接的决定，属说话之中作出的决定，用 will；一般现在时与过去时都与“现在就要做”冲突。
drills.trap: be going to 要求打算在说话前已经形成，而这里没有任何事先打算的迹象。

drills.stem: Look at those black clouds! It ___ (rain) at any moment.
drills.hint: Look at 引出的是眼前可见的证据。
drills.explain: Look at those black clouds 提供可见迹象，at any moment 又强调迫近，这类预测用 be going to；主语 it 搭配 is。

drills.stem: I will going to take the early train tomorrow.
drills.answer: I am going to take the early train tomorrow.
accept: I am going to take the early train tomorrow.
I will take the early train tomorrow.
drills.explain: will 与 be going to 都是将来标记，同一个谓语不能同时出现，须删去其中一个。

drills.stem: I ___ you with your luggage; it looks heavy.
drills.explain: 看到对方行李重而主动提出帮助，是说话时作出的承诺，用 will help。
drills.trap: am helping 描写正在帮这个动作，无法表达“我来帮你”这一主动承担。

drills.answer: Look at those dark clouds. It is going to rain.
drills.explain: 乌云是可见迹象，有证据的预测用 be going to；be going to 后接动词原形 rain，不能加 -ing。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: She is going to study medicine in London.
drills.explain: 学医是早已定下的打算，用 be going to + 动词原形；in London 是地点状语。

items.title: 现在进行时与一般现在时表将来
items.brief: 已定行程用进行时，时刻表用现在时

concept.summary: 现在进行时表“已安排好、即将发生”的将来，主语多为人，动词多为位移或明确的社交安排，如 go、come、leave、arrive、fly、meet、have dinner。一般现在时表将来则限于时刻表、日程表这类机构排定的事项。两者的共同机制是用“已经确定”替代将来标记，区别在确定性的来源：个人安排用进行时，机构时刻表用一般现在时。

sections.h: 进行时表将来：已定行程
sections.p: 这类句子几乎都带将来时间状语或明确的上下文，否则会被读成“此刻正在做”。位移动词最常这样用，因为行程一旦订好就已成事实。
bullets: We are flying to Tokyo on Monday.
I'm meeting my tutor at three tomorrow afternoon.
She's getting married in June.
They are leaving for Xi'an this evening.

sections.h: 一般现在时表将来：时刻表
sections.p: 主语换成交通工具、课程、影剧、会议，谓语后面跟具体钟点或日期，就是机构排定的日程。这类句子不涉及说话人的意愿，只陈述安排。
bullets: The flight takes off at 6:40.
The film starts at eight.
Term begins on September 5.
The exhibition closes on Sunday.

sections.p: 第一，没有安排依据的预测不能塞进进行时；第二，进行时表将来只指一次性的安排，与频率状语同现就会自相矛盾。
bullets: × It is raining tomorrow. √ It is going to rain tomorrow.
× We are flying to Tokyo every Monday. √ We fly to Tokyo every Monday.
位移与社交动词最常见：go, come, leave, arrive, fly, start, return, meet

examples.en: We are flying to Shanghai on Friday morning.
examples.zh: 我们周五上午飞上海。
examples.note: 机票已定，属已安排的行程，进行时表将来。

examples.en: I'm meeting my tutor at three tomorrow afternoon.
examples.zh: 我明天下午三点见导师。
examples.note: 约见已定，meet 用进行时表将来。

examples.en: The flight takes off at 6:40 tomorrow.
examples.zh: 航班明天六点四十起飞。
examples.note: 航班时刻属机构排定，用一般现在时表将来。

examples.en: The film starts at eight tonight.
examples.zh: 电影今晚八点开场。
examples.note: 排片表上的开场时间，用一般现在时。

examples.en: It is raining tomorrow, so take an umbrella.
examples.zh: 明天要下雨，带把伞。
examples.note: 天气预测没有任何安排依据，不能用进行时表将来，应改为 It is going to rain tomorrow.

examples.en: We are flying to Tokyo every Monday.
examples.zh: 我们每周一飞东京。
examples.note: every Monday 表反复，进行时只能指一次安排，应改为 We fly to Tokyo every Monday.

examples.en: She is starting her new job next Monday.
examples.zh: 她下周一开始新工作。
examples.note: 入职日期已定，进行时表已安排的将来。

examples.en: My plane leaves at 6:15 tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 我的航班明天早上六点十五起飞。
examples.note: 航班号与起飞时间属时刻表信息，用一般现在时。

pitfalls.wrong: I meet my supervisor at ten tomorrow.
pitfalls.right: I'm meeting my supervisor at ten tomorrow.
pitfalls.why: 个人约见属已安排的行程，用进行时表将来；一般现在时在这里会被读成每周都见的习惯。

pitfalls.right: It is going to snow tomorrow.
pitfalls.why: 天气预测没有既定安排作依据，进行时无法承载，须用 be going to。

pitfalls.wrong: We are visiting the museum every Sunday.
pitfalls.right: We visit the museum every Sunday.
pitfalls.why: every Sunday 要求反复义，进行时只指一次性的安排，两者互相排斥。

contrast.withTitle: will 与 be going to 的语义差别
contrast.diff: 进行时表将来要求“已安排”，且多指较近的具体行程；will 与 be going to 不限远近，也不要求已有安排。

concept.mnemonic: 人已约，用进行；机构排，用现在；频率状语一出现，两个都不能用。

core: 进行时表将来 = 已安排的具体行程，通常带将来时间状语
一般现在时表将来 = 时刻表与日程表，主语多为航班、课程、影剧、会议
没有安排依据的预测用 be going to，不用进行时
进行时表将来只指一次安排，不能与 every day 类频率状语同现
review.trigger: 看到 tomorrow/next week 加已定行程 → 用进行时；看到具体钟点加机构日程 → 用一般现在时

quickCheck.a: We are flying to Tokyo next Monday.

quickCheck.q: The film ___ (start) at eight tonight. 填什么？
quickCheck.a: starts，按排片表用一般现在时。

quickCheck.q: 能说 It is raining tomorrow 吗？
quickCheck.a: 不能，改为 It is going to rain tomorrow.

drills.stem: We ___ dinner with the Smiths at eight tonight; the table is already booked.
drills.explain: 餐桌已订，说明这是说话前定好的安排，用进行时表将来；at eight tonight 提供将来时间。
drills.trap: have dinner 若用一般现在时，会被读成经常一起吃饭的习惯，与“已订桌”这一次安排矛盾。

drills.stem: Our plane ___ (take) off at 6:40 tomorrow morning, according to the ticket.
drills.hint: according to the ticket 说明这是航班时刻。
drills.explain: according to the ticket 把句子限定为航班时刻表信息，用一般现在时表既定日程；主语 our plane 为三单，take 加 -s。

drills.stem: I meet my tutor at three tomorrow afternoon to discuss the essay.
drills.answer: I am meeting my tutor at three tomorrow afternoon to discuss the essay.
accept: I am meeting my tutor at three tomorrow afternoon to discuss the essay.
drills.explain: 与导师的约见属个人已定行程，用进行时表将来；一般现在时会把它读成固定习惯。

drills.stem: The film ___ at 8:15, so let's meet at the entrance at eight.
drills.explain: 排片表上的开场时间属机构日程，用一般现在时表将来；let's meet at eight 也确认事件尚未发生。
drills.trap: started 与 was starting 需要过去时间参照，与 let's meet 指向的将来矛盾。

drills.answer: We are flying to Tokyo next Monday.
drills.explain: 机票已定属个人安排的行程，用现在进行时表将来；fly 是位移动词，next Monday 点明将来时间。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: I am meeting my supervisor at ten tomorrow.
drills.explain: 约见已定，用现在进行时表将来；at ten tomorrow 是安排的具体时间。

items.title: be to do 与 be about to do 表将来
items.brief: be to 表安排规定，be about to 表即刻

concept.summary: be to do 表示按计划、义务、命令或规定“应该发生”，常见于通知、规章、新闻，时间可远可近。be about to do 表示“马上、即刻”就要发生，与说话时刻的距离几乎为零，因此不与具体将来时间状语连用。两者的分界是时间跨度：be to do 带安排或义务色彩，be about to do 只覆盖眼下这一瞬。

sections.h: be to do 的三种色彩
sections.p: 这个结构的共同点是把将来写成外部给定的安排，而不是说话人的意愿。计划、义务、规定三类语境最常见，否定形式表示禁止。
bullets: 计划安排：The President is to visit Japan next month.
义务命令：You are to hand in the essay by Friday.
规定与禁止：No one is to leave the room. / Visitors are not to feed the animals.

sections.p: about 在这里表示“即将”，时间距离接近零，因此句中不能再出现具体时段或日期。它最常出现在 be about to do ... when ... 这一句式里，when 引出打断的事件。
bullets: The train is about to leave.
We were about to start when the lights went out.
× The train is about to leave in ten minutes.
× I am about to finish the report next Friday.

sections.p: 同一个将来事件可以用四种结构，差别在于信息来源：说话人的意愿、说话人的打算、外部规定、即刻发生。选错结构句子仍然通顺，但语义偏移。
bullets: will：说话人的决定、承诺、预测
be going to：说话前已有的打算、有迹象的预测
be to do：外部给定的计划、义务、规定
be about to do：眼下这一瞬即将发生

examples.en: The Queen is to open the new hospital next month.
examples.zh: 女王下月将为新医院揭幕。
examples.note: 正式日程安排用 be to do，语气比 will 更书面。

examples.en: You are to report to the manager at nine tomorrow.
examples.zh: 你明天九点向经理报到。
examples.note: 上级给定的义务用 be to do。

examples.en: Students are not to use mobile phones during the exam.
examples.zh: 考试期间学生不得使用手机。
examples.note: 规定性禁止用 be not to do，not 位于 to 之前。

examples.en: The train is about to leave, so hurry up.
examples.zh: 火车马上要开了，快点。
examples.note: be about to do 表即刻发生，与 hurry up 的紧迫感一致。

examples.en: The train is about to leave in ten minutes.
examples.zh: 火车十分钟后就要开了。
examples.note: about to 已含“即刻”，不能再与 in ten minutes 这样的时段连用。

examples.en: I am about to finish the report next Friday.
examples.zh: 我下周五就要写完报告了。
examples.note: next Friday 距现在还有多日，与 about to 的零距离冲突，应改用 will finish。

examples.en: The meeting is to be held in the main hall.
examples.zh: 会议将在主楼大厅举行。
examples.note: be to do 的被动形式，用于公布既定安排。

pitfalls.wrong: The plane is about to take off in half an hour.
pitfalls.right: The plane will take off in half an hour.
pitfalls.why: about to 表示即刻发生，与 in half an hour 这样的时段状语在时间距离上冲突。

pitfalls.wrong: You are to not smoke here.
pitfalls.right: You are not to smoke here.
pitfalls.why: be to do 的否定词 not 放在 to 之前，构成 be not to do，而不是插在 to 与动词之间。

pitfalls.wrong: He is about to go to bed at ten every night.
pitfalls.right: He goes to bed at ten every night.
pitfalls.why: about to 只描写一次即刻的动作，无法与 every night 的反复义共存。

contrast.withTitle: will 与 be going to 的语义差别
contrast.diff: will 与 going to 表达说话人取向的将来；be to 把将来写成外部规定或正式安排，be about to 只覆盖眼下这一瞬。

concept.mnemonic: be to 是安排与规定，be about to 是马上；not 放 to 前，具体时间不跟 about to。

core: be to do：计划安排、义务命令、明文规定，时间可远可近
be to do 的否定是 be not to do，not 位于 to 之前
be about to do：即刻将发生，时间距离接近零
be about to 不与 tomorrow、in ten minutes 等具体时间连用
be about to do ... when ... 是高频句式，when 引出打断事件
review.trigger: 看到 notice、rule、contract 类语境 → be to do；看到 Hurry up、马上 → be about to do

quickCheck.q: “闲人免入”这类规定用哪个结构？
quickCheck.a: be to do，如 No one is to enter.

quickCheck.q: 能说 The train is about to leave in ten minutes 吗？
quickCheck.a: 不能，about to 不与具体时段连用。
be not to do，如 You are not to smoke here.

drills.stem: According to the notice, all students ___ gather in the hall at 7 p.m.
drills.explain: notice 引出的是校方规定，属外部给定的安排，用 be to do；at 7 p.m. 是规定的具体时间。
drills.trap: are about to 表示即刻发生，无法与 at 7 p.m. 这样的具体时间点搭配。

drills.stem: We were just ___ to leave when the phone rang.
drills.hint: just 与 when 一起提示“正要……这时……”。
drills.explain: be about to do 表示即刻将发生，just 加强“正要”的意思，when 引出打断的事件，因此填 about。

drills.stem: The manager is about to hold the meeting at nine tomorrow morning.
drills.answer: The manager is to hold the meeting at nine tomorrow morning.
accept: The manager is to hold the meeting at nine tomorrow morning.
The manager will hold the meeting at nine tomorrow morning.
drills.explain: at nine tomorrow morning 距现在尚远，与 about to 的即刻义冲突；改用 be to do 表既定安排。

drills.stem: According to the contract, the goods ___ be delivered by the end of June.
drills.explain: contract 是外部规定，by the end of June 又是一段将来时间，用 be to do 表约定事项。
drills.trap: are about to 只覆盖眼下这一瞬，与 by the end of June 的时间跨度矛盾。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: The minister is to visit Japan next month.
drills.explain: 正式访问属已公布的安排，用 be to do；next month 说明时间可远，正合 be to 的用法。

drills.stem: 快一点，电影马上要开始了。
drills.answer: Hurry up, the film is about to start.
drills.explain: “马上”对应 be about to do，时间距离接近零，因此句末不能再加具体时段。
